engine: cql-execution + cql-exec-fhir, the same compiled ELM used for the cohort run
provenance: fixtures authored by hand from the rule statement, not produced by the generative model

results.name: flag + thin fluids + not nil-by-mouth
results.covers: the conjunction satisfied — the alert-raising cell

results.name: flag + thin fluids + nil-by-mouth as an Observation
results.covers: the nil-by-mouth exclusion in its Observation form — never emitted by the cohort

results.name: flag + thin fluids + an active order carrying no oral diet
results.covers: the nil-by-mouth exclusion in its order form

results.name: flag + thin fluids on a cancelled order
flag with status `amended` + thin fluids
results.covers: the `amended` arm of the status filter — unreachable for profile-conformant data
results.nonConformanceReason: AspirationRiskFlag fixes Observation.status to `final`; this fixture violates that on purpose to reach the branch.

results.name: flag recorded years earlier + thin fluids
results.covers: temporal scope: the rule carries no validity period, so a stale flag still fires

results.name: flag + a subsumed IDDSI concept instead of the Level 0 code

results.name: flag with status `preliminary` + thin fluids
results.covers: the status filter in the alert-raising direction
